verdict.summary: Round 2 confirms the prior approval. The selector remains fail-closed: the optimization is enabled only with a resolvable merge base and readable blobs, while missing PyYAML, parsing failures, content differences, and declined proofs retain the existing full-run trigger. The conjunction is sound for the stated scope: verbatim equality of all non-comment lines prevents YAML source rewrites that PyYAML might normalize differently from GitHub Actions, and parsed-document equality detects whole-line comment changes that alter block-scalar contents. Selection wiring preserves unrelated crate and full-run triggers. The tests exercise both load-bearing proof halves, dependency absence, unreadable and malformed inputs, decline auditing, eligibility, fallback behavior, and mixed-path selection without appearing vacuous.
